<h1 id="kerapac-the-bound-duo-hm-necromancy" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Kerapac, the Bound - Duo HM Necromancy</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/1fZdXd5U3v.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This guide assumes you are already familiar with the basic mechanics of Kerapac which can be seen here </nowiki><span><nowiki>#kerapac-hm-basic</nowiki></span><nowiki> and own BIS gear in Necromancy.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>It is recommended to have a Nodon dragonkin slayer task </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> as the genocidal boost does work with Necromancy. You may also use the premier Artefact </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/918517285176623104.png?v=1" alt="premierartefact" title="premierartefact" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to have a 10% chance to not decrease.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="additional-notes"><ins><nowiki>Additional Notes</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>One person should do each of these rotations to avoid overlapping </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1" alt="bloat" title="bloat" kind="icon" /><nowiki> &amp; redundant casts of </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1" alt="invokedeath" title="invokedeath" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
